label: Which tier a request lands in
section: Which tier a request lands in
subgoals: Classify the request as a value change, a new function or a core change
Check whether the engine already exposes the needed knob
Extend the seam once when a request recurs outside it

label: What a weight change selects
subgoals: Normalize each objective against the baseline
Score each candidate with the new weights
Switch to an epsilon constraint when no weight reaches the wanted design

label: Proving a weight change worked
subgoals: Run the reference designs and check the legality invariants
Compare QoR deltas against the baseline on both objectives
Repeat seeds when the effect is near the noise level
